aboutContent.title: 🎨 Creative at Heart
aboutContent.description: I love bringing ideas to life visually before a single line of code is written. Whether it’s sketching wireframes on paper or designing sleek UI components in Figma, creativity is always at the core of what I do. Design, to me, isn’t just about how it looks — it’s about how it works.

aboutContent.title: 🎧 Fueled by Music
aboutContent.description: My best work is often accompanied by the rhythm of music. From chill lo-fi beats during deep focus sessions to energizing tracks when pushing deadlines — music keeps my mind sharp and my flow uninterrupted

aboutContent.title: 🌙 Late-Night Dev Flow
aboutContent.description: There’s something magical about building features in the quiet of the night — when everything’s still, and ideas flow effortlessly. It’s my favorite time to get into deep focus and bring concepts to life.

aboutContent.title: 🎮 Play = Progress
aboutContent.description: Gaming is more than just fun — it sharpens my problem-solving mindset. Whether it’s strategy, storytelling, or UI in game menus, I find design inspiration in the digital worlds I explore.

aboutContent.title: 🌐 Passion for Development
aboutContent.description: There’s something exciting about the web’s endless possibility. I love building things that live online — accessible, responsive, and open to the world. Each project is a chance to contribute something useful and beautiful to the internet.

journeyItems.title: B.Sc Computer  Technology
journeyItems.organization: sri krishna adithya college of arts and science
journeyItems.description: During my college, I mainly learned the basics of HTML and CSS. I worked on creating simple web pages, designing layouts, styling elements, and understanding the basic structure of websites. I also gained a basic understanding of how frontend web development works.

journeyItems.title: Mobile App development  internship
journeyItems.description: I completed a 15-day internship at NoviTech R&D Pvt. Ltd. During the internship, I mainly focused on learning Java basics and Android Studio. I learned basic Java concepts, Android project structure, UI components, and the fundamentals of Android application development. It was mainly a learning-based internship.

journeyItems.title: Flutter Full Stack Development
journeyItems.description: I completed Flutter Full Stack Development training at N School. During the training, I learned Dart and Flutter for mobile application development. I also learned the  Python and MySQL, including database concepts and CRUD operations. Through the training, I gained practical knowledge of building Flutter applications and understanding how frontend, backend, and database components work together

journeyItems.title: Flutter Developer
journeyItems.description: I worked as a Flutter Developer Intern at SagbOTS. My main role was developing and modifying Flutter UI screens using Dart. I also worked on API integration, debugging, and improving application functionality. This internship helped me gain practical experience in real-world Flutter development.
